title: Choice dialog
responsibility: Wraps supplied choices in a modal opened from an icon button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.label
inputs.description: Required accessible name for the trigger and dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.title
inputs.description: Required tooltip on the opening button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.disabled
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, disabling the trigger. Does not close an already-open dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.activeCount
inputs.description: Number of active jobs to show in the deployment dialog heading.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.width
inputs.description: Required preferred width in pixels, capped at viewport width minus 24 pixels.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.maxHeight
inputs.description: Required maximum height in pixels, capped at dynamic viewport height minus 24 pixels; overflow scrolls.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.gap
inputs.description: Optional gap between dialog-grid children in pixels; defaults to 6.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.icon
inputs.description: Required content rendered inside the trigger button.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.onopen
inputs.description: Callback invoked when the dialog opens so its latest contents can be loaded.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.children
inputs.description: Required content function receiving a close callback for dismissing the dialog after selection.

outputs.name: ChoiceDialog
outputs.description: Trigger and modal. Opening focuses an enabled aria-pressed=true choice when present. Escape closes this dialog and stops propagation; backdrop click also closes it. Closing returns focus to the trigger.
